privacyBody: This companion gives estimates from statistical models. Prices, payments, values and returns are scenarios, not promises, and not financial, legal or tax advice. Check every figure with the developer and a licensed professional before you sign or pay.
What we keep: your chat messages and the profile you share (goal, budget, horizon, areas) so the conversation continues when you come back. Your browser keeps only a session id.
Your contact details (name, phone, email) go to a broker only when you ask to be contacted or agree to it in the chat. The time of your agreement is saved with the lead.

We do not sell your data. Personal data is handled under Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law (No. 151 of 2020). To see or delete your data, contact the broker who called you, or start a new chat to stop using the saved one.
